evals.prompt: I just finished writing 10 new money pages for the Florida region. Walk me through everything I need to do before uploading to the host.
evals.expected_output: The full delivery gate: rebuild (prebuild → Astro → fetchpriority → sitemaps), validate data, check SEO (0 issues), check word counts, random 5-page review, tracker sync, then upload dist/ contents to the web root.

evals.prompt: My build passed but the sitemap URL count doesn't match the rendered page count. What do I check?
evals.expected_output: Troubleshooting steps: verify unique: true on all intended pages, check for empty region sitemaps excluded from index, confirm the generate-sitemaps.js walks dist/ correctly, and that no routes render without content.

evals.prompt: Set up cache headers for my Apache host. I have hashed asset bundles (JS/CSS), images, fonts, and HTML pages.
evals.expected_output: An .htaccess config with mod_deflate for compression, mod_expires with immutable 1-year for hashed bundles, ~1 week for images/fonts, ~1 hour for HTML, and a custom 404 Document.
